title: Immunostaining of Drosophila embryos
author: Artem Ilin
materials: Dilute primary antibodies (according to antibody reference) in 500 µL of PBSBT for each sample. Add antibody mix to your samples. Place at rotator in the cold room overnight.
Remove the primary antibodies from your samples and save them for a potential reuse. Wash embryos 3x 00:05:00 with PBSBT. Wash 3x 00:15:00 with PBSBT.
Add secondary antibodies (fluorescent) according to primary (organism) diluted 1:800 in 500 µL PBSBT. Cover the tubes in foil and place on rotator for 02:00:00 Room temperature

steps.title: Wash basket and transfer embryos to PBS
steps.instruction: Wash the basket with water, then use a brush to transfer embryos from the net into a glass vial containing 1 × PBS.

steps.title: Dechorionate embryos with sodium hypochlorite
steps.instruction: Transfer aged embryos from juice plates to the basket, wash with water, and incubate them in a container with 5 × diluted sodium hypochlorite (6–14 % active chlorine) for 2 minutes; verify dechorionation under a binocular microscope.

steps.title: Fix embryos in heptane‑formaldehyde
steps.instruction: After embryos settle, remove PBS, add 3.6 mL of 1 × PBS, then add 4 mL of heptane and 400 µL of 37 % formaldehyde; place the mixture on a shaker at 350 rpm, °C, for 25 minutes.

steps.title: Methanol extraction of lower phase
steps.instruction: Remove the lower (aqueous) phase, add 5 mL methanol, and shake vigorously by hand for slightly more than 1 minute; wait until most embryos sink, then discard the liquid.

steps.title: Second methanol wash and transfer
steps.instruction: Add another 5 mL methanol, shake briefly, wait until embryos sink, and transfer the embryos in methanol to a 1.5 mL Eppendorf tube.

steps.title: Rehydrate embryos on rotator
steps.instruction: Add 500 µL methanol and 500 µL Milli‑Q water to the tube, then place on a rotator for 10 minutes (00:10:00).

steps.title: Wash embryos with PBST
steps.instruction: Wash embryos three times with 1 mL PBST for 5 minutes each (00:05:00 per wash) on the rotator.

steps.title: Wash embryos with PBSBT (first series)
steps.instruction: Wash embryos four times with 1 mL PBSBT for 15 minutes each (00:15:00 per wash).

steps.title: Wash embryos with PBSBT (second series) and PBS
steps.instruction: Perform three washes with 1 mL PBSBT for 5 minutes each, followed by four washes with 1 mL PBSBT for 20 minutes each, and finish with a single wash of 1 mL PBS for 30 minutes (00:30:00).

steps.title: Mount embryos with VectaShield
steps.instruction: Add 50 µL VectaShield mounting medium containing DAPI to the embryos, place them on glass slides, and cover with a coverslip.
